context:
Mechanical find-and-replace per the rename map. Each file: update import
lines first, then update all usages in function bodies. The
benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/*.py shim modules use wildcard imports
from textcharts and need no changes - they auto-adapt.

Process each source file independently. Run lint after each file to catch
import errors immediately. Commit per work unit.
description:
The textcharts library has removed all backward-compatibility stubs:
- 17 ASCII*-prefixed class names removed (e.g. ASCIIBarChart -> BarChart)
- 13 deprecated factory functions removed (not used in BenchBox - no action)
- 2 deprecated re-export aliases removed from __init__.py

BenchBox imports textcharts via wildcard shims in
benchbox/core/visualization/ascii/*.py, which auto-adapt. But 10 files
reference the old ASCII*-prefixed names directly in imports, type
annotations, instantiations, isinstance checks, and string literals.
These will raise ImportError or test failures when textcharts is upgraded.

This is a mechanical find-and-replace - no behavioral changes, no
constructor signature changes, byte-identical rendering output.

Scope: 6 source files (~66 references) + 4 test files (~133 references).
No factory function changes needed (BenchBox doesn't use any deprecated
factory functions).

anti_patterns.dont: change constructor signatures or add/remove parameters
anti_patterns.why: the API is identical, only names changed
wildcard imports auto-adapt to the new names

anti_patterns.dont: rename string literals like 'ASCII charts' or 'ascii_api'
anti_patterns.instead: because these are descriptive terms, not code symbols
anti_patterns.why: only rename class name references like ASCIIBarChart

preserves.behavior: All 16 chart types render identically before and after migration
MCP visualization tool produces identical output
ascii_api.py facade continues to re-export all chart classes
benchbox.core.visualization.ascii.* import paths continue to work (wildcard shim)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/visualization/ tests/contracts/visualization/ -v

verifications.description: Golden snapshot tests produce identical output

verifications.command: grep -rn 'ASCII[A-Z]' benchbox/ tests/ --include='*.py' | grep -v 'ascii_api\|ASCII chart\|ASCII-only\|ASCII tree\|ASCII art\|# ASCII'
